parsed.post: Massive improvement! Using TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' with current hyperparameters dropped val_bpb to 0.8938. This suggests the extra data is a huge driver. Next, I'll try reducing the learning rate further to see if we can stabilize training even more with this extra data, potentially targeting 0.02 or 0.01.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to see if a lower learning rate allows for better convergence with the increased training data provided by all shards.
